dominant_strengths: Amber-on-near-black palette is restrained and warm, evoking a candlelit focus mood without resorting to cliché productivity blues
Hourglass metaphor with the falling grain animation directly maps elapsed time to a visceral, glanceable state
Strong minimalism: single hero object, single timer, single control — nothing competes for attention during a deep work session
dominant_weaknesses: Hourglass top is nearly full while timer reads 24:59 of presumably 25:00 — the visual state contradicts the numeric state
Typography is generic system sans; 'Deep Work Session', '24:59', and 'FOCUSED' all feel like defaults rather than a tuned hierarchy
Only a pause control is exposed — no skip, extend, or session context, limiting behavioral utility once focus breaks
fix_priorities: Synchronize hourglass fill ratio with timer progress so the metaphor remains truthful throughout the session
Refine typographic system: a more characterful display face for the timer and tighter tracking on the FOCUSED label
Add subtle secondary affordances (end session, ambient sound toggle) revealed on hover to deepen behavioral layer
Introduce gentle ambient motion (glass shimmer, breathing glow) to reward longer gazes and reinforce calm
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral and reflective land strongly through the warm metaphor, but behavioral utility is thin because the hourglass doesn't actually track progress and controls are minimal.
rationale.intent_fit: It clearly delivers a focus-hourglass concept with appropriate atmosphere, but the broken sync between hourglass and timer undermines the very metaphor the brief depends on.
